text: In the stated tenant/trespasser setting, the Court held that the landlord retained legal or constructive possession through the tenant and could seek Section 6 recovery when that tenant was forcibly dispossessed by a third party. This resolves standing, not independently verified title or filing timeliness.

For that landlord Section 6 action, tenant joinder could be desirable but was not an absolute prerequisite; non-joinder did not by itself defeat maintainability. This does not decide title or all remaining statutory requirements.
